steps.en: Build the codec bridge against the copy of 剪映 already on your Mac, then check the app version and library hash
steps.zh: 对着本机已安装的剪映编译 codec 桥接，再核对应用版本与库哈希

steps.en: Describe the edit as one JSON plan: tracks, segments, timings
steps.zh: 把剪辑写成一份 JSON 计划：轨道、片段、时间

steps.en: Build the draft into an isolated work directory
steps.zh: 把草稿构建到独立的工作目录

steps.en: Encrypts and writes 剪映's native draft files, copies the media, and verifies every file against the plan
steps.zh: 加密写出剪映原生草稿文件、复制素材，并逐个文件对照计划校验

steps.en: Quit 剪映 completely, then register the draft on the local home list
steps.zh: 完全退出剪映，再把草稿登记进本机首页列表

steps.en: The draft opens in 剪映 as a normal, editable multi-track project
steps.zh: 草稿在剪映里打开，就是一个普通可编辑的多轨工程

steps.en: Ask for a finished MP4 when you need one
steps.zh: 需要成片时再要一条 MP4

steps.en: The app's own engine renders H.264/AAC in a sandbox that denies network access
steps.zh: 应用自己的引擎在禁网沙箱里渲染出 H.264／AAC

value.en: An editable multi-track 剪映 project — plus a native MP4 when asked — from one JSON plan: timeline assembly is automated, the last mile stays hand-editable
value.zh: 一份 JSON 计划换来可继续编辑的剪映多轨工程，需要时再出原生 MP4：时间线拼装被自动化，最后一公里仍可手工精修
